description: Returns the cited quotes behind a hotel's scores. Each one carries the outlet that published it, what kind of document it was, and its url. Answers what a hotel is actually like: whether it is quiet, whether the beds are good, whether service holds up. Returns a Markdown list of up to `limit` quotes (default 12, max 40), spread across the axes unless narrowed to one, each with its outlet, document kind and url. Some hosts are returned as "a guest review" with no name or link. An unknown slug returns near matches; no evidence on an axis is stated as such.

category.description: Narrow to one axis. Omit for a spread across all of them, which is the right default for an open question.

name: get_evidence
title: Get cited evidence
